play_short.text: Build daily habits, plan routines, track streaks and stay consistent.

apple_description.text:
Build a routine around the habits that matter to you.

Create daily habits, organize morning and evening routines, and use a simple checklist to mark what you finish. Set habit reminders to help you remember your plan.

See your streaks and calendar history as you build consistency. Review your progress, adjust your routines, and keep going one day at a time.

RitualLoop is a habit tracker for everyday routines.

play_full.text:
Make room for your daily habits with RitualLoop.

CREATE YOUR ROUTINE
Add the habits you want to practice and group them into morning or evening routines. Use your daily checklist to see what is left and mark completed habits.

SET REMINDERS
Choose reminders for your habits so your plan is easier to remember.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Track streaks and review your habit calendar. Look back at completed days and adjust your routine as your goals change.

KEEP IT SIMPLE
Use one place for daily habits, routine checklists and progress tracking. Start with a routine that fits your day.

RitualLoop supports everyday habit planning.
